title: VPN, proxy and strong-encryption services
summary: Mostly secondary sources (VPN vendor blogs, which have commercial bias); verify against Freedom House, OONI and Access Now before relying. Classifications differ between sources.

countries.name: China
countries.note: Only state-licensed VPNs lawful (MIIT 2017 notice); unlicensed VPN provision criminal.

countries.name: Russia
countries.note: VPNs must connect to the Roskomnadzor blocklist (2017 law); non-compliant services blocked; promotion of VPNs banned 2024.

countries.name: Belarus
countries.note: VPN/Tor use and provision restricted since 2015; enforcement heightened during unrest.

countries.name: Iran
countries.note: Only government-approved VPNs lawful; unauthorized use penalised.

countries.name: Iraq
countries.note: Some sources list a ban; enforcement unclear.

countries.name: North Korea
countries.note: Internet tightly controlled; VPNs effectively unavailable. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Myanmar
countries.note: Cybersecurity law (2025) criminalises unlicensed VPN use. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: VPN use lawful only for lawful purposes; using to commit crime or bypass blocks is punishable (Federal Decree-Law 34/2021).

countries.name: Egypt
countries.note: VPN apps widely blocked; legal status unclear. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Uganda
countries.note: Social-media tax and blocking led to VPN restrictions; no formal ban. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.note: PTA requires VPN registration; unregistered VPNs blocked (2024). from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.note: No formal ban; VPN providers have been blocked. Some sources say no prohibition.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: VPN use allowed for businesses; use to access blocked content prohibited. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: India
countries.note: CERT-In directions (2022) require VPN providers to retain logs for 5 years and register user data.
